title: Rakshak AI - Disaster Survival Fine-Tuning
description: Fine-tunes Gemma 4 E2B IT with Unsloth QLoRA for Rakshak AI, an offline disaster survival companion for India. Covers alert-to-action JSON, Hindi/English voice distress intent parsing, grounded NDMA/WHO survival RAG, and 2-sentence situation briefs. Outputs a LoRA adapter for 4-bit LiteRT-LM export and on-device inference via flutter_gemma.
